_about: Dungeon Quiz Quest content: Depths (runs of floors, top to bottom) and the monsters. Edit freely; the server checks it at startup. A floor is made up fresh for each match: RoomCount [fewest, most] rooms, each filled at random from Pool to about RoomHp (1 to MaxPack monsters: the party fights the first, the others wait their turn, and a Wizard's fast answer hits them all), then the Boss's room. Questions = how often each difficulty is asked on that floor (weights). A floor can also be written out instead: "Monsters": [a, b] (a room each) or "Rooms": [[a, a], [b]]. Monster: Sprite = a built-in placeholder key (see wwwroot/js/pixel-sprites.js) or a picture path like /media/dungeon/goblin.png once the real art exists; Hp and Damage on the first pass (each loop back to the top adds LoopHpBonus to HP and LoopDamageBonus to damage; a party of several gets tougher monsters, Game:Dungeon:PartyHpPerMember); Damage = HP a hit takes off the adventurer; AttackSeconds = the monster's hourglass (the one in front's counts). MinigameChance = how likely each floor is to have a mini game between two of its rooms (at most one a floor, never right before the boss; each kind of mini game as likely as the others; Game:Dungeon:Minigames has their numbers). Sized so an average solo player beats about two bosses in a 3-4 minute session (Game:Dungeon:ClockStartSeconds and the time per kill).
